Meanwhile, Syd is at a reunion party, determined to prove his legendary speed in a race against old rivals, all for the ultimate prize of bragging rights.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles' day is thrown into chaos when a giant worm with metal jaws starts chewing through the floor, heading directly for the Shrinkinator! After a desperate battle to stop the chomping menace, they face a new crisis. They discover that babysitting two baby ants is incredibly difficult, a problem made worse when Adilla's roaches begin kidnapping all the ant babies to create a new army, forcing the team into a daring rescue mission.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Arpo and Baby Daniel are causing chaos all over town! The adventure starts at the supermarket when Daniel runs off with a giant lollipop, leading to a wild chase with Arpo's rockets on the fritz. Then, a relaxing fishing picnic turns into a wilderness survival test when a thieving squirrel tries to steal their food! Plus, the family gets a mischievous new puppy that Arpo has to keep from making messes and a stroller goes on the loose, forcing Arpo to chase it through town!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some total mayhem caused by Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel finds the remote to control Arpo, turning the robot babysitter into everything from an elephant to a bird! Then, Arpo is tasked with cleaning the kitchen, but Daniel just wants to play, making an even bigger mess. From getting covered in mud to being extra noisy while Daddy is trying to sleep, Baby Daniel keeps Arpo on his toes in this fun-filled, chaotic adventure!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: It's a day of crazy competitions and robot malfunctions! First, a friendly competition in the park turns into a wild go-kart race between Arpo and his rival, Nannybot! Then, Arpo's own systems go haywire. A toy's music makes him dance uncontrollably all over the backyard, and a malfunctioning birthday present massage chair chases him and Daniel around the house! From boomerang target practice to a building block showdown, the chaos never stops!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some tricky situations! First, Slick receives a knitted hat from Newt that he hates, so he comes up with a plan to 'accidentally' lose it so he doesn't hurt her feelings. Then, Fuse's terrible temper while watching sports gets him in trouble, and he has to try his best to keep a lid on it while watching a game with Newt. The trouble continues when Jeff gets a mysterious itch and blames it on a sleeping Zee!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: It's a day of art, money and bad medicine for the Oddbods! When Jeff kicks Pogo out of his art class, Pogo decides to make his own crazy creations, which become incredibly popular, much to Jeff's horror. Then, Zee strikes oil in his backyard and becomes a 'Zeellionaire'! How will his new money affect his friendships? Plus, Zee tricks Newt into thinking he's sick so she'll take care of him, but how long can he keep up the act?

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for a competitive day with the Oddbods! When Newt is laughed out of the boys' go-karting activities, she resolves to teach them a lesson and prove she's more than a match for them in a race. Then, Jeff isn't the most athletic, and when he gets roped into a sports game against some overly competitive Greybods, he finds he's out of his depth. Plus, Pogo discovers a remote control that can pause and rewind real life!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi and Meekah embark on a rhyming and musical adventure at Rockwood Music Hall! They explore rhythm by playing various instruments like drums and tambourines, creating their own music. Their journey culminates with meeting musical guest Sonia De Los Santos who teaches them how to write a song and invites them to perform with her on stage!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi enjoys a day of playtime! He rides rollercoasters, learns about transportation and plays on a colorful jungle gym with a new friend.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: How does a recycling truck work? What happens on a farm? Will this object Sink or Float? Blippi explores the world around us with silly dance moves, fun songs, and awesome adventures. There is so much to learn about, it will make you want to shout 'BLIPPI'!

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku
programme.desc: Hannah and her friend Alia have gone to an abandoned construction site to find material for her YouTube channel, but she unknowingly records a murder.

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Diam Tanda Setuju
programme.desc: Kisah dua sahabat baik yang berhadapan dengan konflik perhubungan di saat mereka mula panik memikirkan usia mereka yang semakin meningkat tetapi belum bertemu jodoh.

programme.title: Nasiya
programme.desc: Ketika melarikan diri dari bekas suaminya, Ihyana telah mengalami kemalangan tetapi dia bernasib baik kerana telah diselamatkan oleh satu entiti luar biasa yang telah mengubah kelakuannya.

programme.title: Suamiku Encik Beruang
programme.desc: Ani, the most beautiful girl in the village, who is ever man's fantasy, decides to marry Mr. Bear as her husband, much to everyone's surprise. As for the chief village, he intend to organise the "wedding of the year".

programme.title: Menanti Hari Itu
programme.desc: Kisah kasih sayang seorang ibu terhadap anak kandungnya yang tidak pernah terpadam meskipun si anak menjauhkan diri akibat hasutan keluarga angkatnya sendiri.

programme.title: Kecundang Sebelum Menjanda
programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Aku Raja Lawak
programme.desc: Silah nak jadi pelawak yang terkenal, cuma di kampungnya tak ada peluang pekerjaan pelawak sepenuh masa. Tapi dia tetap mendapat sokongan padu daripada peminat nombor satunya – iaitu Faris, anaknya.

programme.title: Puyah & Putat
programme.desc: Kisah pengembaraan Puyah, seorang gadis kampung becok yang disukai ramai, apabila dia melawat Kuala Lumpur dan termasuk set filem secara tak sengaja, dan tak semena-mena mula mendapat nama sebagai pelakon.

programme.title: Ting Tong, Love
programme.desc: Bored by his mother's insistence on his getting married, Hairi finally agrees on the condition that he could choose his own soul mate. Does the choice of Hairi meet with his mother's approval?

programme.title: Chomel
programme.desc: After her mother's death, Mimi's family fell apart. One day, Mimi finds Chomel, a cat and brings it home, only for it to cause a series of events that brings her broken family back together again.

programme.title: My Future Husband
programme.desc: Emily berharap untuk menemui bakal suami dan pada suatu hari muncul seorang lelaki bernama Atta yang mengaku dia adalah suami Emily dari masa hadapan.

programme.title: Perangkap Perkahwinan
programme.desc: Three best friends promised to get married, at the same time when they turn 26 years old. Their perceptions of marriage life begin to change and conflict ensues.

programme.title: Cik Puan Sinderella
programme.desc: This is a lighthearted family drama about a teenage girl who is closely guarded by her mother.

programme.title: Anak Kerak
programme.desc: Husin telah menggunakan ilmu hitam iaitu dengan ‘Anak Kerak' demi untuk mendapatkan kekebalan, kesenangan dan kemewahan hidup di dunia.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Jatuh Cinta Buta
programme.desc: Telefilem komedi romantik tentang perkenalan singkat di antara Zulin, seorang gadis yang tidak pernah bercinta, dengan Izlan, seorang duda dalam satu 'blind date' yang diaturkan oleh Nadya Ramanshah.

programme.title: Matahari
programme.desc: Fauzi seorang guru yang telah dihantar untuk berkhidmat di Sabah. Di sana dia telah berkenalan dengan seorang novelis yang sedang mengalami masalah ‘writer’s block’ iaitu Yazid.

programme.title: Meniti Cinta Di Starimost
programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Jula Juli Bintang Putus Cinta
programme.desc: Telemovie sekuel Jula Juli Bintang Cinta kini kembali! Kali ini, Jula dan Juli mengalami konflik percintaan dengan Dani & Izham sehingga mereka memutuskan untuk berpisah dan melarikan diri ke kampung Juli.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat
programme.desc: Kampung Kuala Lambat bagai mengalami sumpahan apabila lelaki yang berkahwin muda akan mati di hari pernikahan mereka namun kejadian ganjil ini tidak berlaku kepada lelaki yang berusia 60 tahun ke atas.

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am
programme.desc: We’ll be back at 6.00am.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta
programme.desc: Kupid Cubit is a dating app that enables the masses to find love. But for Katarina and Saiful, it's a platform for healing people with unrequited love.

programme.title: Duit Kawin
programme.desc: Memaparkan pemikiran remaja sekarang terhadap perkahwinan dari sudut kos atas syariat agama tetapi tertekan cara hidup zaman kini yang mahukan kemewahan.

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi
programme.desc: Kisah penulis lagu Maya Arisa yang menghidap tumor otak dan mengimpikan untuk berkahwin. Dia kemudiannya bertemu dengan seorang jurugambar bernama Redza.

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam
programme.desc: Suraya is a naive village girl who looks forward to happy days when Hazrul proposes to her. But those happy days are only temporary when she learns who Hazrul really is.

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Hunting Games
programme.desc: Two dangerous armed men must hunt each other and fight to death over millions of dollars in cash in this high octane wilderness survival story.

programme.title: Escape Through Africa
programme.desc: Following a violent raid on her outpost, a British nurse, Anne is on the run with a small group of soldiers. She must balance bravery with compassion to save a native girl, her husband, and her colony.

programme.title: Blindfire
programme.desc: A police officer who while responding to a violent hostage call, kills the African American suspect only to later learn of his innocence. Sensing this was a set-up, and facing repercussions, he must track down the person responsible while examining his own accountability and the ingrained racism which brought him to this point.

programme.title: Pocket Listing
programme.desc: Double crosses, adultery, murder, mistaken identity, and revenge ensue when a mysterious power player and his sultry wife hire a disgraced Los Angeles property broker to discreetly market and sell their Malibu villa.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement
programme.desc: Hayes Hodges, an attorney, takes up the offer of defending his friend Colonel Terry Childers, accused of ordering his squad to open fire on a group of demonstrators.

programme.title: Enter The Clones of Bruce
programme.desc: Enter the Clones of Bruce dives into the Bruce Lee exploitation craze, otherwise known as Bruceploitation.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: The Jews of Eastern Europe are being massacred by the thousands. Galvanised into action after the death of his wife, Hungarian barrister Sonson finds himself leading an inspirational fight back against the increasingly desperate and dangerous Nazis.

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page, a brilliant mother-daughter swindler team, target the city's wealthiest men. Max marries them and then sues for alimony after she catches them involved in an affair with Page.

programme.title: The Commando

programme.title: PART 1
programme.desc: Across the world an unprecedented Category 6 storm descends. The Eiffel Tower is shredded by violent winds. Mount Rushmore crumbles under hurricane-level pressure. The Great Pyramids are reduced to pile of rubble as black funnels snake across the desert. Unprecedented "tornado alleys" develop across two continents And when a bizarre plague of frogs terrorizes New York’s Museum of Natural History, religious zealots compete with scientists for a rational explanation. For years, scientists have been expounding theories—and warnings—of global-warming effects. Finally someone is listening: Judith Carr (Gina Gershon, Face/Off), newly appointed head of FEMA. It’s disaster, Code Yellow, as the "storm on steroids" is only just beginning to rend the earth.

programme.title: PART 2

programme.title: DAY 4
programme.desc: As the day of his predicted death approaches, a deeply depressed J.T. seems resigned to his fate. He creates a video will, leaving everything to Jesse, and tries to record some words of wisdom to help his daughter when he’s gone. Meanwhile, Jesse manages to get into the briefcase and becomes distraught over the case file inside. But Jesse isn’t ready to give up, and after J.T. explains the situation, she convinces him he must keep fighting back.

programme.title: Opah Popular
programme.desc: Badrul dan Sofia bertugas di luar negara. Setelah lama merantau beliau balik ke Malaysia dan menghabiskan cuti dengan balik ke kampung. Anaknya tidak suka kerana mereka dipaksa untuk tinggal bersama opah.

programme.title: Bas Stop!
programme.desc: Selebriti dan pelawak mengalami sendiri situasi sebenar kehidupan seharian seperti pemandu teksi, peniaga, pembaiki kasut, penyanyi jalanan dan pelbagai lagi dalam mengetengahkan isu-isu yang dihadapi dari sudut komikal.

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: There's excitement as the first baby giraffe to be born at Flamingoland is due at any moment. Can Dr. Matt ensure a safe delivery? And a young male rhino needs a medical MOT before he can meet some females but he just won't co-operate. Meanwhile a macaw with a twisted beak presents Matt with a bit of a challenge.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In the UK nearly a quarter of the adult population have made a dog part of their family. But there are some reports RSPCA inspectors respond to that have them thinking otherwise, and in Staffordshire Inspector Charlotte Melvin is left reeling from the shock of what she finds when she investigates one such case. She receives a complaint about a house full of animals, some in cages and living in cramped and dirty conditions. When she arrived things looked so bad that Charlotte calls the police who help her gain access to the property. Inside there's a menagerie of different creatures, from a fox to a snake, to a lizard, all suffering in totally unsuitable quarters. Two of the worst affected are dogs Mocha and Lexi. Mocha has extreme hair loss. As well as having the same terrible skin problems as Mocha, Lexi is also severely emaciated. Charlotte must act fast to help all the animals to survive.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo. nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population.

programme.title: ...Make You Laugh Out Loud
programme.desc: From Christmas as you've never experienced it before, with out-of-tune carol singers, Santa getting stuck, ungrateful children and exploding Christmas puddings - to OAP's, kids and even blundering burglars, six brand spanking new topics are given the trademark LOL treatment, combining user-generated footage with comic narration by comedian Iain Lee. There's a treat too for animal lovers with a Puppies special featuring some of the cutest, as well as funniest, puppy clips on the web.

programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In this special edition of the Dog Rescuers we go to Hong Kong. The RSPCA doesn't just look after the welfare of dogs here in the UK, but also collaborates with parts of Europe, Asia and Africa. programme.desc: Julie heads South of the border to face her fear of heights in Tulum, take in some waves in Ensenada, and participate in Día de los Muertos in Mexico City.

programme.title: Side Hustles
programme.desc: From a lawyer to an actor to an insurance analyst, Stephanie discovers a world of folks who’ve turned their passion for cooking into side hustle food businesses. From dumplings, sushi and pretzels she explores how they balance their day jobs.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Cooking with Fire
programme.desc: Stephanie meets 3 cooks who use fire in different ways to create distinct dishes. Using their love of cooking over an open flame; these cooks introduce her to the diverse flavors of Armenia; a classic Italian hero, and infrared grilled Brazilian BBQ.

programme.title: Secret Pizza
programme.desc: With the help of a guide, Stephanie Izard explores the underground secret pizzas of Los Angeles, including an off-menu pizza at a cinnamon bun pop-up, apartment-cooked limited drop specials and gourmet sourdough pies made in pizza van’s mobile oven.

programme.title: Life After Restaurants
programme.desc: From backyard mariscos to Cantonese remixes of British hand pies to made-to-order slap noodles, Stephanie catches hangs with 3 chefs who left the traditional restaurant scene and found alternative ways to cook for a living and make the food they love.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Joys of Jamaican Cooking
programme.desc: Stephanie challenges herself to learn more about Caribbean food. Meeting with home cook Kat Williams, who teaches her about Jerk chicken and the art of rice and peas and then restaurant owner Chef Tony who shows her the secret to oxtail.

programme.title: Middle East Street Food Eats
programme.desc: Stephanie highlights the diversity of Middle Eastern cuisine through the lens of street food. Cooking Pakistani kebabs with home chef, Izza Khan, and then learning the complexity of Israeli street food at Dr. Sandwich.

programme.title: Stephanie and the Pitmaster
programme.desc: Stephanie joins UPS driver and home chef, Fernando Carrillo, for a backyard BBQ and a trip to LA institution Carnitas el Momo to learn the subtle art of slow cooking and the techniques of flavor.

programme.title: Legacies and Thai Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie cooks Thai and Peruvian dishes with home chef Brittaney Bunjong and swaps stories about growing up in the kitchen with their moms. Rediscovering the joys and influence of those flavors on her own cooking.

programme.title: Key Ingredients of West African Cuisine
programme.desc: Stephanie meets Nigerian chefs, Eros and JP, to learn the basics of cooking West African cuisine. From palm oil to locust beans to asaro; Stephanie tests her knowledge and her skills - using these unfamiliar ingredients.

programme.title: Amsterdam & Paris
programme.desc: Amsterdam is a city unlike any other. As the capital of the Netherlands, it’s home to a plethora of historic sights and culinary delights. Known as The City of Light, Paris can feel anchored in another time, while a dynamic food scene keeps evolving.

programme.title: Dublin & Copenhagen
programme.desc: In Dublin, verdant fields yield impeccable produce, and the coastal waters offer the finest seafood. nCopenhagen's food scene caters to all, and regardless of where you eat, it's high quality, locally sourced, and globally inspired.

programme.title: Barcelona & Rome
programme.desc: Barcelona is defined by quirky architecture, imaginative food and vibrant street life. n "Cucina Romana," is unique to Rome and vastly different from every other part of Italy.

programme.title: New York & D.C.
programme.desc: NYC's long immigration history and numerous urban and ethnic clusters have greatly influenced its food and culture. Steeped in rich history, Washington, D.C. is home to all three branches of the government — but it’s not all politics and power suits.

programme.title: Nashville & Chicago
programme.desc: Over the past decade, Nashville has evolved beyond a destination for country music - it’s a culinary powerhouse too. Once known for deep-dish pizza and hot dogs, Chicago is quickly becoming one of the country’s most revered culinary destinations.

programme.title: Honolulu & Los Angeles
programme.desc: Fine dining or a traditional plate lunch in Honolulu, there's no mistaking that myriad cultures influence the islands’ culinary flavors. In L.A., go beyond Hollywood hot spots - these folks serve authentic dishes from across the world.

programme.title: Julie's Adventures in Mexico
programme.desc: Julie heads South of the border to face her fear of heights in Tulum, take in some waves in Ensenada, and participate in Día de los Muertos in Mexico City.

programme.title: Seaside Scallops with a Salad and a Sweet
programme.desc: Chef Stuart O’Keeffe sears up some scallops with smashed crispy fingerlings and roasted tomatoes. He also dishes up an herbed salad, a light and refreshing vodka cocktail, and a fresh and creamy strawberry parfait.

programme.title: Hot Fried Chicken Sando on A Furikake Bun
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval serves up a hot fried chicken sandwich on a homemade furikake bun with Japanese mayo and southern-style slaw. On the side, he preps deliciously crispy hand-cut fries - dig in to this fried feast!

programme.title: Poolside Shrimp Taco Platter
programme.desc: Chef Angie Lee transports you to Baja, Mexico with her crispy tempura fried Baja shrimp tacos with salsa, black beans, and cilantro cauliflower rice. Corn salad with chipotle dressing adds a good crunch too!

programme.title: Egg Yolk Raviolo with Whipped Ricotta
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto shows us the art of pasta making by creating a gorgeous raviolo. This pasta is filled with egg yolk and fluffy ricotta in a brown butter sauce. A tomato salad and orange blossom cookies finish it all off.

programme.title: Pork Katsu & Spicy Curry
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval makes his version of a Japanese katsu and curry with a breaded and fried pork cutlet and a spicy vegetable curry laced with lemongrass and garlic. On the side, a Hawaiian potato salad made with bacon!

programme.title: Coastal Seafood & Chocolatey Churros
programme.desc: LA Native Chef Angie Lee’s Baja shrimp and rockfish ceviche gets a citrusy twist. Mexican sea bass is served with a colorful corn slaw and spicy grilled pineapple, and fried churros with gooey chocolate are for dessert.

programme.title: Roast Chicken & Bread Salad
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe shows us how to make his perfect lemon & garlic roast chicken. A simple panzanella and burrata salad is up next, followed by his chewy no-bake crispy date cookies, which are to die for.

programme.title: Sweet on You
programme.desc: Sweet potatoes and a sweet tooth - Frankie's got you covered on the cheap and full of nutrition. Some times, you've got to indulge!

programme.title: Save Dough, Make Dough
programme.desc: Prepping meals at home is cheaper and way more nutritious! Frankie makes portable breakfasts for the work week and forays into the stuffed dough of different cultures.

programme.title: Cheese Please
programme.desc: When it comes to delicious dinners, isn’t everything better with cheese? We’ve got bacon cheeseburger bombs, potato cheese pie, even deep-fried grilled cheese! Lactose intolerant folks beware - this is a cheesy doozy.

programme.title: Mini Meals
programme.desc: Sometimes you want a whole lotta food and sometimes just a taste. Luckily you can get all the flavor you need in a smaller size with these mini onion blossom bites, tiny taquitos, and bacon cheeseburger bombs.

programme.title: I'm Stuffed
programme.desc: Get your grub on with these sumptuous stuffed savory meals. We're making gravy stuffed biscuits, giant ravioli, and pesto pockets to fill up your dinner plate and your belly!

programme.title: All About the Apps
programme.desc: Who needs a main meal when you can fill up on appetizers? From cauliflower fritters, to chicken wings, to tiny taquitos we're starting this party off right!

programme.title: On the Water
programme.desc: Guy takes a trip on the floating markets of Thailand, gathers barnacles on the deadly cliffs of Portugal, and throws a drool-worthy feast in Melbourne.

programme.title: Island Hopping
programme.desc: Guy discovers that island life is not all ocean swims and sun bathing... at least not while sourcing matcha in Japan, deadly Stone Fish in the Philippines and ingredients for a local feast in Orcas Island.

programme.title: All the Markets
programme.desc: Green markets, fish markets, all the markets! Guy heads to Italy, Japan, and the California's Central Coast and discovers where some of the oldest, most sacred and freshest ingredients come from.

programme.title: From Volcanoes to Redwoods
programme.desc: From Sicilian pistachios grown in the shadow of Mount Etna, to an epic feast under the California Redwoods Guy travels to some of the most visually stunning areas in the world to source and cook with amazing ingredients.

programme.title: Guys' Night Out
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith shares his Guys’ Night Out favorite moment and meal of lemon pepper chicken wings and loaded fries from his days in Houston playing football. Solo meals also sizzle with Nashville Hot Chicken and Waffles and Curry Chicken Salad.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season
programme.desc: It’s holiday time and Chef Derrell is feeling festive and making a feast fit for a king with crown roast and sweet potato gratin. A Monte Cristo sandwich screams Christmas for a solo dish and is delivered with sweet and snowy powdered sugar on top.

programme.title: No Kitchen No Problem
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us a few easy and inventive "no-kitchen" hacks for delicious struggly meals. If you're dorm living or road tripping, it doesn’t mean you can’t make tasty meals from handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It’s tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at. It’s time to spring into action with these delicious meals that are light on your plate and your wallet.

programme.desc: The Day of Gluttony hits French Canada's culinary epicenter to take in some of the culture and amazing food on offer in historic Montreal.

programme.title: 24 New Orleans Restaurants in 24 Hours
programme.desc: The Day of Gluttony heads South as Harry and Bruce take on The Big Easy, and learn a thing or two about Southern cuisine, and New Orleans voodoo.

programme.title: No Kitchen No Problem
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us a few easy and inventive "no-kitchen" hacks for delicious struggly meals. If you're dorm living or road tripping, it doesn’t mean you can’t make tasty meals from handy kitchen (and non-kitchen) appliances. No Kitchen? No problem.

programme.title: Spring Fling
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to cook with mother nature, spring-style. It’s tasty, seasonably affordable, and pretty to look at. It’s time to spring into action with these delicious meals that are light on your plate and your wallet.

programme.title: Sweet on You
programme.desc: Sweet potatoes and a sweet tooth - Frankie's got you covered on the cheap and full of nutrition. Some times, you've got to indulge!

programme.title: Save Dough, Make Dough
programme.desc: Prepping meals at home is cheaper and way more nutritious! Frankie makes portable breakfasts for the work week and forays into the stuffed dough of different cultures.

programme.title: Cheese Please
programme.desc: When it comes to delicious dinners, isn’t everything better with cheese? We’ve got bacon cheeseburger bombs, potato cheese pie, even deep-fried grilled cheese! Lactose intolerant folks beware - this is a cheesy doozy.

programme.title: I'm Stuffed
programme.desc: Get your grub on with these sumptuous stuffed savory meals. We're making gravy stuffed biscuits, giant ravioli, and pesto pockets to fill up your dinner plate and your belly!

programme.title: All About the Apps
programme.desc: Who needs a main meal when you can fill up on appetizers? From cauliflower fritters, to chicken wings, to tiny taquitos we're starting this party off right!

programme.title: All the Markets
programme.desc: Green markets, fish markets, all the markets! Guy heads to Italy, Japan, and the California's Central Coast and discovers where some of the oldest, most sacred and freshest ingredients come from.

programme.title: From Volcanoes to Redwoods
programme.desc: From Sicilian pistachios grown in the shadow of Mount Etna, to an epic feast under the California Redwoods Guy travels to some of the most visually stunning areas in the world to source and cook with amazing ingredients.

programme.title: Guys' Night Out
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith shares his Guys’ Night Out favorite moment and meal of lemon pepper chicken wings and loaded fries from his days in Houston playing football. Solo meals also sizzle with Nashville Hot Chicken and Waffles and Curry Chicken Salad.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season
programme.desc: It’s holiday time and Chef Derrell is feeling festive and making a feast fit for a king with crown roast and sweet potato gratin. A Monte Cristo sandwich screams Christmas for a solo dish and is delivered with sweet and snowy powdered sugar on top.

programme.title: Hot Fried Chicken Sando on A Furikake Bun
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval serves up a hot fried chicken sandwich on a homemade furikake bun with Japanese mayo and southern-style slaw. On the side, he preps deliciously crispy hand-cut fries - dig in to this fried feast!

programme.title: Poolside Shrimp Taco Platter
programme.desc: Chef Angie Lee transports you to Baja, Mexico with her crispy tempura fried Baja shrimp tacos with salsa, black beans, and cilantro cauliflower rice. Corn salad with chipotle dressing adds a good crunch too!

programme.title: Egg Yolk Raviolo with Whipped Ricotta
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto shows us the art of pasta making by creating a gorgeous raviolo. This pasta is filled with egg yolk and fluffy ricotta in a brown butter sauce. A tomato salad and orange blossom cookies finish it all off.

programme.title: Pork Katsu & Spicy Curry
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval makes his version of a Japanese katsu and curry with a breaded and fried pork cutlet and a spicy vegetable curry laced with lemongrass and garlic. On the side, a Hawaiian potato salad made with bacon!

programme.title: Coastal Seafood & Chocolatey Churros
programme.desc: LA Native Chef Angie Lee’s Baja shrimp and rockfish ceviche gets a citrusy twist. Mexican sea bass is served with a colorful corn slaw and spicy grilled pineapple, and fried churros with gooey chocolate are for dessert.

programme.title: Roast Chicken & Bread Salad
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe shows us how to make his perfect lemon & garlic roast chicken. A simple panzanella and burrata salad is up next, followed by his chewy no-bake crispy date cookies, which are to die for.

programme.title: Sweet on You
programme.desc: Sweet potatoes and a sweet tooth - Frankie's got you covered on the cheap and full of nutrition. Some times, you've got to indulge!

programme.title: Mini Meals
programme.desc: Sometimes you want a whole lotta food and sometimes just a taste. Luckily you can get all the flavor you need in a smaller size with these mini onion blossom bites, tiny taquitos, and bacon cheeseburger bombs.

programme.title: On the Water
programme.desc: Guy takes a trip on the floating markets of Thailand, gathers barnacles on the deadly cliffs of Portugal, and throws a drool-worthy feast in Melbourne.

programme.title: Island Hopping
programme.desc: Guy discovers that island life is not all ocean swims and sun bathing... at least not while sourcing matcha in Japan, deadly Stone Fish in the Philippines and ingredients for a local feast in Orcas Island.

programme.title: Kimchi & Other Korean Classics
programme.desc: This menu is Chef Angie Lee’s love letter to her Korean roots. She’s making a veggie mixed rice bowl called bibimbap complete with cucumber kimchi and a classic seaweed soup. A yuja cha soda drink tops it all off.

programme.title: Not Your Mom's Meatballs & Gnocchi
programme.desc: Chef Joe Sasto is paying homage to his mom’s meatballs, but adding in some mortadella and fennel salame! He’s pairing them with homemade ricotta gnocchetti and roasted carrots. For dessert, a no-churn banana ice cream.

programme.title: Fancy Free
programme.desc: Going to the movies is expensive! Frankie shows us how to make a delicious TV dinner, popcorn, and dessert for less money than a movie ticket! Then, French food isn’t all fancy and expensive. These are meals big on flavor and light on your wallet!

programme.title: Going With the Grain
programme.desc: Frankie teaches you how to prep ingredients to make delicious, healthy meals for a fraction of the time and cost.

programme.title: Meatless Masterpieces
programme.desc: The verdict is in - you don’t need meat to make it a meal. These meat-free favorites are just as tasty. Spaghetti & meatless balls, star spinach pie, or creamy curry cauliflower -these veggie dishes are just as delicious!

programme.title: Spicy Specialties
programme.desc: Calling all hot food aficionados! If you’re one who likes to spice things up in the kitchen, we’ve got jalapeno popper cornbread, peel n’ eat shrimp, or buffalo chicken pull-apart bread - get ready to feel the burn.

programme.title: Go For Game Day
programme.desc: When gathering to watch the game, it's important that everyone be chewing while they cheer! From peel-and-eat shrimp, to a jalapeno burger dog, and inside out nachos, we've got something for every fan.

programme.title: Oodles of Noodles
programme.desc: Whether it's sweet potato pasta, ramen carbonara, or a leftover pasta frittata, these dishes are a noodle nerd's dream. There'll be carbs all around while we bake, fry, and boil to pasta perfection!

programme.title: Regional Favorites
programme.desc: Whether it’s mole in Mexico or tiramisu in Italy, Guy gets a taste of regional specialties and uncovers the ingredients that give them their characteristic flavor.

programme.title: Found in the Wild
programme.desc: Guy takes it back to our hunter-gatherer days as he forages on both land and sea for aromatic truffles, giant mushrooms and coastal clams.

programme.title: Catch of the Day
programme.desc: Guy uncovers the many ways to catch a fish... and oysters! From fly fishing in Seattle, braving Australia's crocodile infested rivers for Barramundi and hand picking oysters on the Puget Sound, there's never a dull moment on the water.

programme.title: At the Frontlines of Food
programme.desc: Guy connects with local artisans and farmers throughout Spain and California to get a closer look at the people who grow olives, raise goats and make bread. Using ingredients from local farmers, he creates a mouth watering feast to remember.

programme.title: Ultimate Taco Tuesday
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is doing Taco Tuesday his own delicious way with pernil tacos, mexican street corn and homemade guacamole. The fiesta continues with solo meals of pork empanadas and dessert for dinner with flambe maduros with vanilla ice cream.

programme.title: Traditional Fish Fry
programme.desc: A traditional and delicious fish fry is served with cornmeal crusted fried whiting fish, hushpuppies and coleslaw. Chef Derrell Smith also pairs fish beignets with his signature spicy sauce in addition to cultural takeaways from this celebration.

programme.title: Spice Is Nice
programme.desc: Flavor, flavor, flavor. Frankie shows us the way around the spice cabinet. All it takes is a couple primary dried spices to make a variety of homemade spice blends. Bonus: Frankie also tackles a monster challenge with our favorite monster guest!

programme.title: Root-to-Stem
programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to use whole vegetables, from root-to-stem, which means no food goes to waste. Learn how to use vegetable stalks you would normally throw away. Root-to-stem cooking: less waste, more food, and more nutrition. Frankie’s favorite.

programme.title: Bring Your Own Lunch
programme.desc: Frankie is all about BYOL - bring your own lunch. It’s not only good for your wallet, it’s good for your health. Skip the vending machine and the cafeteria in favor of creative, cost effective and easy-to-transport midday meals.

programme.title: Korean Short Ribs with Pineapple Sauce & Coconut Rice
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval brings backyard grilling fun into the kitchen. Korean short ribs soak in a pineapple huli huli sauce, with a side of coconut jasmine rice and cucumber salad...then black sesame ice cream for the win!

programme.title: Irish Crispy Fish & Chips
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe puts a modern twist on fish n’ chips by adding champagne batter, a malt vinegar aioli, and the thrice cooked chips. On the side, smashed minty peas, and a delicious dump cake for dessert.

programme.title: The Chicken or the Egg
programme.desc: Which came first? In this episode, it's the egg. Frankie shows us both high and low maintenance ways to prepare roasted chicken and eggs for any meal. Who says adulting has to be hard?

programme.title: Frankie's Day Out
programme.desc: Frankie shows you how to make a week's worth of meals on a single trip to the grocery store, and then shows you three options for struggle meals on the go.

programme.title: High On Pie
programme.desc: Who says pie is just for dessert? We’re serving up some savory pies that are to die for. Pizza pot pie, hot Cheeto pie, or even a quick chicken version - these pies have got flavor and we’ve got the crust to prove it.

programme.title: Take A Dip
programme.desc: Nothing helps out a host more than arriving with a tasty dip...but have you ever made a Korean BBQ chicken dip, loaded baked potato dip, or even a pizza dip? Might be time to start prepping for your next block party!

programme.title: In the Raw
programme.desc: No need to turn your stove on for these delicious raw dishes! We've got poke tuna tacos, avocado pesto, and a crunchy raw veggie sushi that is sure to make your meal both filling and flavorful.

programme.title: Grilled to Great
programme.desc: Fire up the grill because we've got some great grub for you! We're making grilled pork belly, spicy chicken tacos, and gooey grilled cheese kabobs.

programme.title: Filipino Fare
programme.desc: Everyone has their favorite cheat meals, but if you care about your health you can't eat them all the time. Chef Erwan Heussaff tackles some traditional Filipino dishes and finds ways to make even the most unhealthy ones a little better for you.

programme.title: All About Noodles
programme.desc: Who doesn't love a hot bowl of Ramen or a big plate of Pad Thai? Chef Erwan Heussaff attempts to remove the guilt and lower the calories by trying to some unique tricks that make these classic dishes a little better for you without losing the flavor.

programme.title: Asian Cuisine
programme.desc: In this episode of Lightened Up, Erwan reinvents some classic Asian dishes like, Korean "Fried" Wings and Sweet & Sour Chicken, to show people you don't have to compromise on flavor or quality when making foods a little healthier.

programme.title: The More Cheddar the Better
programme.desc: Erwan creates healthier alternatives to two classic cheesy dishes: Mac N’ Cheese and Grilled Cheese.

programme.title: Break Up Meal
programme.desc: Comfort foods are being served up for the lovers, single folks or the recently broken-hearted as Chef Derrell prepares his delicious lobster mac n’ cheese, fire-roasted tomato bisque with lobster grilled cheese sandwiches and zucchini ribbon rolls.

programme.title: Burgers and Shakes
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith shares his diner favorites and childhood memories with smash burgers, shakes and homemade tater tots. His twist on New York City’s bodega chopped cheese sandwiches are loaded on waffle tots that will please any late night cravings.

programme.title: Warm + Cozy Winter
programme.desc: Frankie gets cozy in the Struggle kitchen with recipes that bring all the warmth, flavor and joy during the coldest days of winter. From a casual weekday dinner to a special weekend meal, these dishes are sure to keep you warm and cozy.

programme.title: Eggscellent Techniques
programme.desc: In this special technique episode, Frankie teaches us several methods for cooking a quintessential ingredient: eggs. The scramble, the omelet, the Benedict – learn to make them just the way you like them.

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: As summer heats up, the creators sweat it out in the kitchen putting an original spin on corn ribs and a transforming watermelon into a savory dish. Who will whip up this year’s hottest recipe?

programme.title: Dish in Disguise
programme.desc: The internet falls fast for snacks and hacks that look like one thing but taste like another. Creators must make "donuts" with anything but traditional batter, then flip the script on ramen, using it in an unconventional yet recognizable way.

programme.title: Make It or Bake It
programme.desc: Baking videos send our social media feeds in a frenzy and we can’t seem to get enough. Watch as creators impress the judges with a show stopping focaccia, then pay tribute to the mini pancake cereal trend by concocting their own unique cereal.

programme.title: Chicken or the Egg
programme.desc: No matter which came first, neither one is leaving the internet anytime soon. Creators aim to reinvent two iconic viral recipes, starting with a jazzed up egg sandwich sensation, and then their most innovative bucket of fried chicken.

programme.title: Extra-delicious
programme.desc: They say go big or don’t go at all. When it comes to some viral recipes, going all out is the method to internet madness. Creators customize a burrito made of homemade cotton candy, then shoot for the moon in an over the top nacho spread.

programme.title: Burgers and Shakes
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith shares his diner favorites and childhood memories with smash burgers, shakes and homemade tater tots. His twist on New York City’s bodega chopped cheese sandwiches are loaded on waffle tots that will please any late night cravings.

programme.title: Go For Game Day
programme.desc: When gathering to watch the game, it's important that everyone be chewing while they cheer! From peel-and-eat shrimp, to a jalapeno burger dog, and inside out nachos, we've got something for every fan.

programme.title: Oodles of Noodles
programme.desc: Whether it's sweet potato pasta, ramen carbonara, or a leftover pasta frittata, these dishes are a noodle nerd's dream. There'll be carbs all around while we bake, fry, and boil to pasta perfection!

programme.title: Regional Favorites
programme.desc: Whether it’s mole in Mexico or tiramisu in Italy, Guy gets a taste of regional specialties and uncovers the ingredients that give them their characteristic flavor.

programme.title: Found in the Wild
programme.desc: Guy takes it back to our hunter-gatherer days as he forages on both land and sea for aromatic truffles, giant mushrooms and coastal clams.

programme.title: Korean Short Ribs with Pineapple Sauce & Coconut Rice
programme.desc: Chef Logan Sandoval brings backyard grilling fun into the kitchen. Korean short ribs soak in a pineapple huli huli sauce, with a side of coconut jasmine rice and cucumber salad...then black sesame ice cream for the win!

programme.title: Irish Crispy Fish & Chips
programme.desc: Irish Chef Stuart O’Keeffe puts a modern twist on fish n’ chips by adding champagne batter, a malt vinegar aioli, and the thrice cooked chips. On the side, smashed minty peas, and a delicious dump cake for dessert.

programme.title: The Chicken or the Egg
programme.desc: Which came first? In this episode, it's the egg. Frankie shows us both high and low maintenance ways to prepare roasted chicken and eggs for any meal. Who says adulting has to be hard?

programme.title: Frankie's Day Out
programme.desc: Frankie shows you how to make a week's worth of meals on a single trip to the grocery store, and then shows you three options for struggle meals on the go.

programme.title: High On Pie
programme.desc: Who says pie is just for dessert? We’re serving up some savory pies that are to die for. Pizza pot pie, hot Cheeto pie, or even a quick chicken version - these pies have got flavor and we’ve got the crust to prove it.

programme.title: Take A Dip
programme.desc: Nothing helps out a host more than arriving with a tasty dip...but have you ever made a Korean BBQ chicken dip, loaded baked potato dip, or even a pizza dip? Might be time to start prepping for your next block party!

programme.title: In the Raw
programme.desc: No need to turn your stove on for these delicious raw dishes! We've got poke tuna tacos, avocado pesto, and a crunchy raw veggie sushi that is sure to make your meal both filling and flavorful.

programme.title: Grilled to Great
programme.desc: Fire up the grill because we've got some great grub for you! We're making grilled pork belly, spicy chicken tacos, and gooey grilled cheese kabobs.

programme.title: Filipino Fare
programme.desc: Everyone has their favorite cheat meals, but if you care about your health you can't eat them all the time. Chef Erwan Heussaff tackles some traditional Filipino dishes and finds ways to make even the most unhealthy ones a little better for you.

programme.title: All About Noodles
programme.desc: Who doesn't love a hot bowl of Ramen or a big plate of Pad Thai? Chef Erwan Heussaff attempts to remove the guilt and lower the calories by trying to some unique tricks that make these classic dishes a little better for you without losing the flavor.

programme.title: Sweet Shrimp & Spring Veggies
programme.desc: The bounty of spring is on full display in this menu from Chef Shirley Chung. Sweet shrimp are paired with English peas, asparagus is dressed up with black bean sauce and topped with a fried egg.

programme.title: A Southern-Inspired Mother’s Day Meal
programme.desc: For this Mother’s Day, Chef Keith Corbin is making a southern-inspired feast in honor of his grandmother. Spicy Deviled Eggs start the meal and are followed by brined and Grilled Pork Chop topped with Chow Chow, a truly southern pickled relish.

programme.title: Vintage
programme.desc: Frankie cooks his way back in time with his favorite vintage recipes. These oldie-but-goodie dishes are not only nostalgic and comforting, but they’ll also fill you up without costing you a pretty penny.

programme.title: Struggle Sandwich
programme.desc: In a sandwich, every component plays a role. With a supporting cast of fixin’s, and Frankie’s cost-saving homemade twists, these sandwiches just might steal the show.

programme.title: Breakfast For Dinner
programme.desc: Extend your morning menu all the way through the evening with these breakfast for dinner dishes. Everything bagel croissants, honey butter brunch bao, and cheesy asparagus breakfast bites. Try to stay awake for these!

programme.title: New Spin Old Favorites
programme.desc: We all love an old standard, but sometimes a classic dish needs a modern twist. On this episode we have buffalo chicken lasagna, a french fry corn dog, and even tortilla soup made with ramen noodles. Basic is boring!

programme.title: The Perfect Pairing
programme.desc: What’s better than your two favorite things coming together for the best bite ever? With pizza waffles, french fry corn dogs, and a pasta frittata, these dynamic duos will not disappoint.

programme.title: Ball it Up
programme.desc: Nothing better than the perfect-sized bite, and these dishes are great all year ‘round.’ Whether it’s cauliflower balls, tomato soup with mozza-balls, or mac n’ cheese balls, we’re rolling them all out for you.

programme.title: The More Cheddar the Better
programme.desc: Erwan creates healthier alternatives to two classic cheesy dishes: Mac N’ Cheese and Grilled Cheese.

programme.title: Finger Foods
programme.desc: Erwan creates healthier alternatives to traditional finger foods: Nachos and Pizza.

programme.desc: Erwan creates vegan alternatives to a classic American food and an unexpected dessert: Burger and Cheesecake.

programme.title: Healthy Kick
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is starting off the New Year on a healthy kick making delicious dishes including cauliflower steaks with homemade chimichurri sauce, tomatoes and burrata, cauliflower crust veggie pizza and a mystery dish that will be guilt-free.

programme.title: Cinco de Mayo Tostadas & Tamales
programme.desc: Tonight’s menu is all about the greatest hits. Chef Christy Vega is making Tostada Chiquita, Chicken Tamales with her signature Smoked Blanca Sauce, and her treasured recipe for Albondigas Soup, and she’s pairing it all with their Classic Margarita.

programme.title: Mom’s Favorite Indian-Inspired Dishes
programme.desc: For Chef Jamie Lauren, a night out with her mom meant going to their favorite Indian restaurant. Tonight, she is getting nostalgic with her creative and flavorful twist on burgers and fries!

programme.title: Struggle Soup
programme.desc: Warm and hearty bowls of veggies, beans, pasta, and more, these soups will have you returning for seconds all year round. Frankie’s soup blueprints can turn everyday ingredients into extraordinary soups, with endless flavor opportunity.

programme.title: Cabbage, cabbage, cabbage
programme.desc: Cabbage has long been an underrated green on the field, and it’s about time Frankie gives it a starring role. This leafy head proves itself as the versatile ingredient we need it to be, affordable year around, delicious and filling.

programme.title: Super Soup n' Salads
programme.desc: Which appetizer reigns supreme - soup or salad? Why not have both?! We’ve got chicken caesar salad tacos, French onion soup in a bread bowl, and a creamy curry corn chowder that will warm you right up.

programme.title: Good n' Garlicky
programme.desc: Some say garlic is the gift of the gods...and we say there’s nothing better than the garlicky aroma of bacon & mashed potato garlic knots, garlic butter scallops, or gnocchi with garlic marinara. Who needs breath mints?

programme.title: Wasabi & Strawberry Cheesecake
programme.desc: Tastemaker Emmy Cho travels to Shizuoka and Yokohama to discover the secrets of Kit Kat's Wasabi and Strawberry Cheesecake flavors.

programme.title: Matcha & Ogura Toast
programme.desc: Outside Kyoto, Emmy learns the intricacies and traditions of making matcha, and visits a 600-year-old tea farm. Later, Emmy takes in the cafe culture of Nagoya through Ogura toast and a handful of local specialties.

programme.title: Shichimi 7 Spice Blend & Rum Raisin
programme.desc: In Nagano, Emmy heads to a shichimi pepper farm and a 300-year-old spice shop to learn the history of the 7 spice blend. Later, Emmy tries Tokyo's popular treats to find out how rum raisin gained such prominence in the area.

programme.title: Meet the Parents
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith is making Steakhouse classics for his main meal; for his solo meal he’s putting his own twist on a traditional eggs benedict. His mystery meal will of course be a surprise but will hopefully win over even the pickiest parentals.

programme.title: Jerkin' and GRILLIN'
programme.desc: Back from a trip to Negril, Jamaica, chef Derrell Smith brings his favorite dishes back to his own yard! Grillin’ up Jerk Chicken, Saltfish and Ackee, coconut peas and rice and other Caribbean favorites for his two friends.

programme.title: A Cruciferous Delicious Time
programme.desc: No veggie family packs the same nutritious punch as the cruciferous family, and with a shelf life this long, they’ve become a fixture in Frankie’s meal rotation. These delicious and easy-to-make recipes will win everyone over in no time.

programme.title: Crunchy
programme.desc: Reaching textural nirvana is never easy, but Frankie explores several ways to achieve the perfect crunch in his dishes, both savory and sweet. Add this elusive element to your recipes without adding cost to your budget.

programme.title: Mayo: The Secret Ingredient
programme.desc: Who knew mayo could be such a savvy secret agent? It’s a controversial condiment that can unlock the buttery, crispy, decadent codes of our favorite dishes, without leaving a trace of mayo-ness. Best of all, it’s easy to make at home!

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: Summer is coming to a close but there’s still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that’ll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

programme.title: Salad Salad Salad
programme.desc: Amp up your salad game with a little mixing and matching, from light and leafy greens to crisp and hearty toppings, and dressings for all occasions. Frankie shows us how versatile and fulfilling a homemade salad can truly be.

programme.title: Killer Carbonara & Seasoned Salad
programme.desc: Who says a weeknight meal can’t be decadent, delicious, and easy to make? Chef Jason Neroni is taking flavors up and over the edge in his homage to his Italian roots with a few of his favorites: Chopped Salad and Smoked Carbonara Tagliatelle.

programme.title: Mexican-Inspired Family Favorites
programme.desc: As a mother of four boys, Chef Christy Vega has mastered how to please everyone at the table. In this episode, she is whipping up a crowd-pleasing menu both kids and adults will love including guacamole, quesadillas, fish, and a sweet treat!

programme.title: Crispy & Creamy Cali-Soul Food
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Keith Corbin is sharing his personal journey through food with his show-stopping, Cali-Soul menu: Black-Eyed Pea Fritters, Cream of Mushroom Mac & Cheese, and his secret technique to making fried chicken with crispy skin.

programme.title: Grilled Pork with Corn & Greens
programme.desc: Chef Jamie Lauren is showing us how to take your grilling game up to the next level. One element is more delicious than the next. On the menu: her Marinated & Grilled Pork Tenderloin topped with Hazelnut Salsa Macha, Corn Puree, Quick Braised Greens.

programme.title: Enveloped in Sole, Sauce, & Caesar Salad
programme.desc: Chef Shirley Chung combines her experiences of cooking in renowned French and Italian restaurants with her Chinese heritage, to create a one-of-a-kind, out-of-this-world menu with a salad, a fish, and a panna cotta.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer, de vuelta de su dura experiencia en la naturaleza neozelandesa, comentan los altibajos y los momentos cruciales de su reciente aventura.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E01 - Survival Mode
programme.desc: Los hermanos Chris y Casey Keefer reflexionan sobre algunos de los mejores momentos de las dos primeras temporadas de Dropped. Los temas incluyen las cacerías individuales más memorables de los hermanos y cómo Dropped ha evolucionado a lo largo de los años.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E02 - Game Plan
programme.desc: Con el campamento base montado y el frío arreciando, Chris y Casey deben encontrar comida... rápido. Sus niveles de energía se están agotando a medida que comienzan su caza de alces. A medida que pasa el tiempo, los hermanos deben pensar bien para encontrar comida... o arriesgarse a pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E08 - Focused on Food
programme.desc: Laramy localiza algunos ciervos de cola blanca y centra sus esfuerzos en cazarlos.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E09 - Thriving
programme.desc: Abastecidos de comida, Laramy y Siete prosperan en su nueva ubicación. Laramy se centra en la construcción de algunos servicios para hacer la vida más fácil en El Camino.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E10 - Return Home
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete se despiden de su último campamento y regresan a casa.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E01 - Volcanoes
programme.desc: El mayor espectáculo del mundo es también el más feroz. Desperate Hours analiza la fuerza destructiva de los volcanes y examina las erupciones de Montserrat, que devastó media isla caribeña, la erupción de 1973 en la isla islandesa de Heimaey, la erupción de 2010 del Eyjafjallajökull, que bloqueó el tráfico aéreo en Europa, la erupción del Merapi en Indonesia y del monte Nyiragongo en el Congo, y el supervolcán de Yellowstone.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E02 - Earthquake
programme.desc: Cuando la Tierra se mueve de verdad, significa un desastre a escala épica. Horas desesperadas analiza la fuerza destructiva de los terremotos y se fija en el terremoto de Katmandú (Nepal) de 2015, el terremoto de Sichuan (China) de 2008, en el que se calcula que 10.000 niños quedaron atrapados en edificios escolares derrumbados, el terremoto de Puerto Mont (Chile) de 1960, el terremoto de Puerto Príncipe (Haití) de 2010 y el terremoto de Cachemira (Pakistán) de 2005.

programme.desc: The Cassini space craft has completed its mission over Saturn, Juno has reached its target and has commenced its scientific observations of the giant planet Jupiter. and The New Horizons speeds on it its next encounter at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot
programme.desc: El envío de sondas a través del sistema solar es el sueño de los matemáticos y la pesadilla de los ingenieros, que lanzan sondas alrededor de otros planetas para llegar a su destino.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E01 - Introduction to Military Special Forces
programme.desc: "Special Operations" are special divisions of military, police or intelligence services that are highly qualified in specific areas of urban warfare and in a variety of special weapons and technology.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E02 - Introduction to Police Special Operations
programme.desc: A medida que la guerra ha ido evolucionando, muchas técnicas y tecnologías militares han sido adaptadas para su uso en entornos urbanos por unidades policiales de todo el mundo. Este episodio ofrece a los espectadores una perspectiva íntima de lo que se siente al estar "dentro de las cabezas" del personal especial de la policía, y de cómo su uso de estrategias y equipos de estilo militar les permite salvar vidas. Desde el control de disturbios en Sudáfrica y las lecciones aprendidas de sus excesos, hasta la creación por parte del jefe de policía de Los Ángeles, Robert Gates, de un equipo policial de élite S.W.A.T., CQB mostrará cómo, en los últimos 30 años, la lucha contra la delincuencia urbana ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en un escenario militar, en el que ambos bandos utilizan armamento y tácticas cada vez más complejos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E06 - Princess Diana's Legacy
programme.desc: 反思戴安娜公主的遺產，這個節目深入探討了她在突然去世後留下的遺產——她對孩子們、皇室以及愛她的人留下的印象。年輕的王子們在她的葬禮上因其舉止贏得了讚譽，但許多人質疑他們與查爾斯王子的關係未來將會如何發展。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: 從普通學生到王室女友，凱特·米德爾頓已轉變為現實中的公主。在不到十年的時間裡，這位出身普通的女孩贏得了她的王子的心，現在正踏上成為英國未來女王的道路。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E09 - Mercy Kill
programme.desc: 守望者坎比克調查一頭麋鹿受傷的情況，以及試圖妥善處理這件事的獵人。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E10 - Tangled
programme.desc: 一隻受傷的鹿與另一隻雄鹿的角鎖住了，為守衛布朗斯創造了一個困境。.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E04 - Brotherly Love
programme.desc: La falta de oportunidades de caza ha agotado la paciencia de Chris y Casey. Las discusiones se suceden cuando no se ponen de acuerdo sobre si quedarse en el mismo lugar o hacer porteo hasta un nuevo lago. Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E03 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: 特瑞和拉利測試他們在電影中看到的消音槍聲的方式。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E04 - Meet the Smiths
programme.desc: 男孩們測試了電影《史密斯夫婦》中的各種場景。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E07 - Living Planet
programme.desc: Gracias a la observación continua de la Tierra desde la órbita, los científicos han ido recopilando a lo largo del tiempo una serie de datos que revelan muchas cosas sobre cómo respira la Tierra y cómo se sustenta la vida en este Planeta vivo.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E08 - Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Cosmic and x rays, these mysterious and highly powerful particles from deep space are being investigated to finally discover where they come from.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: Tras la caída de la Unión Soviética, muchos países siguieron en disputa a principios de los noventa, a pesar de la independencia de Europa del Este. En 1994 estalló un amargo conflicto entre las fuerzas del movimiento independentista checheno y el ejército regular ruso. A pesar de la abrumadora cantidad de efectivos, armamento y apoyo aéreo, las fuerzas rusas fueron incapaces de establecer un control permanente efectivo sobre la zona montañosa debido a las numerosas y exitosas incursiones de la guerrilla chechena. Los artefactos explosivos improvisados fueron uno de los métodos más eficaces empleados en estas desastrosas incursiones y fueron el telón de fondo de muchos escenarios de batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiadas entre ambos bandos.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E04 - SAS in Northern Ireland
programme.desc: La historia del legado colonial del Imperio Británico en Irlanda del Norte es bien conocida en todo el mundo, pero hay una historia en gran parte no contada de los tiroteos entre y batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiados entre el IRA provisional, el ejército británico y el SAS de élite. Aunque el IRA empleó a menudo técnicas "terroristas" dentro de la ciudad de Londres y en el territorio continental de Inglaterra, no se habla mucho de las técnicas de guerra de guerrillas del Servicio Aéreo Especial británico en Irlanda del Norte desde el comienzo de este conflicto. En este episodio examinaremos cómo la historia del Servicio Aéreo Especial afectó a la formación de todas las fuerzas de élite posteriores y cómo las batallas cuerpo a cuerpo en Irlanda del Norte a finales de la década de 1970 hasta el milenio dieron forma tanto a las fuerzas especiales como a los métodos de resistencia.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: 這個節目提供了一個迷人的機會來窺探20世紀最迷人的女性之一的非凡生活，透過美國的視角來看。它包含了拍賣她的裙子的片段。.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E07 - William And Kate Into The Future
programme.desc: 從普通學生到王室女友，凱特·米德爾頓已轉變為現實中的公主。在不到十年的時間裡，這位出身普通的女孩贏得了她的王子的心，現在正踏上成為英國未來女王的道路。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E09 - Mercy Kill
programme.desc: 守望者坎比克調查一頭麋鹿受傷的情況，以及試圖妥善處理這件事的獵人。.

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E10 - Tangled
programme.desc: 一隻受傷的鹿與另一隻雄鹿的角鎖住了，為守衛布朗斯創造了一個困境。.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E03 - Wind Burnt
programme.desc: El frío intenso y el viento implacable de Saskatchewan hacen que los días y las noches de Chris y Casey sean brutales. Una tormenta añade más dificultad e incomodidad. Mentalmente agotados y hambrientos, los hermanos deben probar nuevas tácticas para encontrar comida y calor.

programme.title: Dropped - S07:E04 - Brotherly Love
programme.desc: La falta de oportunidades de caza ha agotado la paciencia de Chris y Casey. Las discusiones se suceden cuando no se ponen de acuerdo sobre si quedarse en el mismo lugar o hacer porteo hasta un nuevo lago. Las señales de un oso recuerdan a los hermanos que deben mantener la concentración para seguir con vida.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E03 - Silencing Terry
programme.desc: 特瑞和拉利測試他們在電影中看到的消音槍聲的方式。.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S04:E04 - Meet the Smiths
programme.desc: 男孩們測試了電影《史密斯夫婦》中的各種場景。.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E07 - Living Planet
programme.desc: Gracias a la observación continua de la Tierra desde la órbita, los científicos han ido recopilando a lo largo del tiempo una serie de datos que revelan muchas cosas sobre cómo respira la Tierra y cómo se sustenta la vida en este Planeta vivo.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E08 - Cosmic Collisions
programme.desc: Cosmic and x rays, these mysterious and highly powerful particles from deep space are being investigated to finally discover where they come from.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E03 - Russian Army in Chechnya
programme.desc: Tras la caída de la Unión Soviética, muchos países siguieron en disputa a principios de los noventa, a pesar de la independencia de Europa del Este. En 1994 estalló un amargo conflicto entre las fuerzas del movimiento independentista checheno y el ejército regular ruso. A pesar de la abrumadora cantidad de efectivos, armamento y apoyo aéreo, las fuerzas rusas fueron incapaces de establecer un control permanente efectivo sobre la zona montañosa debido a las numerosas y exitosas incursiones de la guerrilla chechena. Los artefactos explosivos improvisados fueron uno de los métodos más eficaces empleados en estas desastrosas incursiones y fueron el telón de fondo de muchos escenarios de batallas cuerpo a cuerpo intercambiadas entre ambos bandos.
